_comment: Jealous-rival reactions: the OFFENDED god speaks when you take a boon from their rival (syncretism). trigger 'rival', toast.

entries.speaker: greece_athena
lines: Ares' gift? After all my counsel? Foolish, soul.

entries.speaker: greece_ares
lines: Athena's schemes? Bah! War needs no clever tricks.

entries.speaker: bali_dewi_sri
lines: You court destruction's hand? The harvest weeps for you.

entries.speaker: bali_batara_kala
lines: Life's bounty? It only delays the ruin I will bring.

entries.speaker: egypt_osiris
lines: You take Set's chaos — he who slew me? Tread carefully.

entries.speaker: egypt_horus
lines: Set's gift? You honor my father's murderer. Beware.

entries.speaker: egypt_set
lines: Siding with my brother's kin? You wound me, mortal.

entries.speaker: norse_tyr
lines: You trust the trickster's gift? Honor forbids it.

entries.speaker: norse_heimdall
lines: I see Loki's hand upon you now. I will be watching.

entries.speaker: norse_loki
lines: Running to the watchmen now? How terribly dull of you.

entries.speaker: japan_amaterasu
lines: My brother's storm? You wound me, little soul.

entries.speaker: japan_susanoo
lines: The sun's light? Tch. The sea bows to no one.

entries.speaker: aztec_quetzalcoatl
lines: The smoking mirror's lies? I expected better of you.

entries.speaker: aztec_tezcatlipoca
lines: The feathered serpent's wisdom? Ha. We shall see.
